message.content:
# Briefing: Meeting with OpenAI
**Date:** November 20, 2026  
**Time:** 10:00 AM (+05:30)

## Recent developments
* **Agentic Payments & Commerce:** OpenAI introduced **ChatGPT Wallet**, initiating a rollout enabling users to have agents complete purchases on their behalf. The feature is initially available to ChatGPT Pro subscribers (18+) in the US with eligible US-issued cards [4].
* **Product & Model Releases:** OpenAI launched **Images 2.6** globally across subscription tiers in ChatGPT and Codex, alongside API availability for variants like GPT‑Image‑2.6 Sunburst and Flare, aiming for faster iteration and better editing controls [2].
* **Model Governance & Safety:** OpenAI published an updated **Model Spec** organized around core values to guide more capable and beneficial AI behavior [3].
* **Platform & Advertising Expansion:** **ChatGPT Ads** expanded to 26 new countries, reaching a milestone of over 100,000 advertisers utilizing the platform [5].
* **Web Standards & Infrastructure:** OpenAI announced support for a common signal allowing website operators to communicate AI training preferences to multiple AI providers simultaneously [1].

## Talking points
* **Agentic Commerce Integration:** Explore how our organization can integrate or leverage the newly launched *ChatGPT Wallet* framework for secure agentic transactions.
* **Enterprise & Advertising Opportunities:** Discuss potential strategies regarding the expansion of *ChatGPT Ads* across international markets and how enterprise tools align with our growth goals.
* **Creative and Visual Workflows:** Evaluate the utility of *Images 2.6* and its API endpoints (Sunburst/Flare) for automated or high-speed visual content generation workflows.

## Open questions
* How does OpenAI plan to scale *ChatGPT Wallet* availability beyond US-issued cards and Pro subscribers internationally?
* What are the specific implementation timelines or metrics for platforms adopting the newly announced common signal for AI web training preferences?
* How does the updated *Model Spec* shape enterprise compliance and custom model tuning parameters moving forward?

## Sources
* [1] OpenAI: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences — https://openai.com/index/helping-websites-express-ai-training-preferences
* [2] OpenAI: Introducing Images 2.6 — https://openai.com/index/introducing-images-2-6
* [3] OpenAI: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI — https://openai.com/index/updated-model-spec
* [4] OpenAI: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet — https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-wallet
* [5] OpenAI: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries as over 100,000 advertisers have used the platform — https://openai.com/index/chatgpt-ads-expands-26-new-countries
